scene: You step onto the cobblestones of Canal Quarter.
picture: A flat side view along a stone canal promenade. On the far left, a yellow water taxi idles in the water. An elderly East Asian man in blue flat cap, orange cardigan, holding a wooden cane stands centre. To his right, an open crimson tea house floats, and a stone bridge spans the canal far right.
shown: a yellow wooden water taxi idling far left with a smiling driver inside
a floating teahouse door painted crimson, standing wide open on the right
a stone arched bridge with carved dragon railings on the far right
